real.original: David: That's 'cuz 'e starded da cut class all the time 'n stopped studying. I passed it 'cuz I pulled 'n all-nighter tryin' da cram for it.
real.en: That's because he started to cut class all the time and stopped studying. I passed it because I pulled an all-nighter trying to cram for it.
real.zh: 因为他后来总逃课，也不学习了。我为了临时抱佛脚熬了一整夜，才考过。
real.speaker: David
real.origin: 教材口语对照

real.original: Lee: I've never taken such a killer test in my life. Unfortunately fer Eric, the prafesser isn' allowin' 'im ta take a make-up.
real.en: I've never taken such a killer test in my life. Unfortunately for Eric, the professor isn't allowing him to take a make-up.
real.zh: 我从没考过这么难的考试。不幸的是，教授不允许埃里克补考。
real.speaker: Lee
real.origin: 教材口语对照

real.original: David: He should'a dropped the class when 'e had the chance!
real.en: He should have dropped the class when he had the chance!
real.zh: 有机会的时候，他就该退掉这门课！
real.speaker: David
real.origin: 教材口语对照

real.original: Karen 'n Janet 'er talkin' on the phone.
real.en: Karen and Janet are talking on the phone.
real.zh: 凯伦和珍妮特正在通电话。
real.speaker: 场景
real.origin: 教材口语对照

real.original: Karen: Hi, Janet. I haven't heard fr'm ya in a while. How are ya?
real.en: Hi, Janet. I haven't heard from you in a while. How are you?
real.zh: 嗨，珍妮特，好久没你的消息了。你怎么样？
real.speaker: Karen
real.origin: 教材口语对照

real.original: Janet: I've been feeling under the weather. I felt blah all morning. Then by the afternoon, I w'z ez sick ez a dog. I starded running a fever 'n akshelly thod I w'z gonna pass out! Fin'lly I had Brad take me da the doctor who said it w'z a bad case 'a the flu which just hasta run its course. I should be rarin' da go soon.
real.en: I've been feeling under the weather. I felt blah all morning. Then by the afternoon, I was as sick as a dog. I started running a fever and actually thought I was going to pass out! Finally I had Brad take me to the doctor who said it was a bad case of the flu which just has to run its course. I should be raring to go soon.
real.zh: 最近不太舒服，整早没精神，下午更是病得厉害。我开始发烧，真以为要晕倒！最后让布拉德带我看医生，说是严重流感，只能等它自然恢复。我应该很快就能精神抖擞了。
real.speaker: Janet
real.origin: 教材口语对照

real.original: Karen: Well, it sounds like you'll definitely pull through. It takes a while da bounce back after havin' the flu, bud I'm sher you'll be back 'n the pink soon. Jus' try da take id easy fer a while.
real.en: Well, it sounds like you'll definitely pull through. It takes a while to bounce back after having the flu, but I'm sure you'll be back in the pink soon. Just try to take it easy for a while.
real.zh: 听起来你肯定能康复。流感后恢复需要时间，但你很快就会恢复健康的。这阵子尽量好好休息。
real.speaker: Karen
real.origin: 教材口语对照

real.original: Janet: Yer right bud I'm too antsy da jus' lie 'n bed. I get bored oudda my mind!
real.en: You're right but I'm too antsy to just lie in bed. I get bored out of my mind!
real.zh: 你说得对，可我实在闲不住，光躺床上会无聊疯的！
real.speaker: Janet
real.origin: 教材口语对照

real.original: Karen: I know what'cha mean. The las' time I w'z sick, I starded ta go stir crazy!
real.en: I know what you mean. The last time I was sick, I started to go stir crazy!
real.zh: 我明白。上次生病时，我待在家里也快憋疯了！
real.speaker: Karen
real.origin: 教材口语对照

real.original: Susan's tellin' Melanie aboud 'er date.
real.en: Susan's telling Melanie about her date.
real.zh: 苏珊正在向梅拉妮讲她的约会。
real.speaker: 场景
real.origin: 教材口语对照

real.original: Melanie: Ya hafta tell me about cher blin' date. How was it? Was 'e drop-dead gorgeous? Was it love 'it firs' sight?
real.en: You have to tell me about your blind date. How was it? Was he drop-dead gorgeous? Was it love at first sight?
real.zh: 快跟我说说你的相亲吧。怎么样？他帅呆了吗？你们一见钟情了吗？
real.speaker: Melanie
real.origin: 教材口语对照

real.original: Susan: Hardly! First of all, I waided fer 'n hour b'fore 'e fin'lly picked me up. I just assumed th'd I w'z bein' stood up. Then when 'e fin'lly did show up, I open' the door da fin' the bigges' nerd standin' there! By the end 'a the ev'ning, he told me thad 'e had a crush on me an' then starded talkin' about tying the knot!
real.en: Hardly! First of all, I waited for an hour before he finally picked me up. I just assumed that I was being stood up. Then when he finally did show up, I opened the door to find the biggest nerd standing there! By the end of the evening, he told me that he had a crush on me and then started talking about tying the knot!
real.zh: 才没有！我等了一小时他才来接，还以为被放鸽子了。他终于出现，我开门却发现站着个超级呆子！到晚上快结束时，他说喜欢我，接着就谈起结婚！
real.speaker: Susan
real.origin: 教材口语对照

real.original: Melanie: On the firs' date?! It w'z prob'ly jus' puppy love. Listen, my advice ta you is that the nex' time 'e asks you out, jus' turn 'im down an' run 'n the opposite direction! Whadever ya do, ya certainly don't wanna lead 'im on.
real.en: On the first date?! It was probably just puppy love. Listen, my advice to you is that the next time he asks you out, just turn him down and run in the opposite direction! Whatever you do, you certainly don't want to lead him on.
real.zh: 第一次约会就这样？！多半只是一时迷恋。我建议下次他约你就拒绝，赶紧远离！无论怎样，都别让他误以为你也喜欢他。
real.speaker: Melanie
real.origin: 教材口语对照

real.original: Susan: I'm sapposta go out with another guy next week, b'd I've decided ta break 'ar date. I jus' can't go through this again.
real.en: I'm supposed to go out with another guy next week, but I've decided to break our date. I just can't go through this again.
real.zh: 本来下周要和另一个男生出去，不过我决定取消。我实在不想再经历一遍。
real.speaker: Susan
real.origin: 教材口语对照

real.original: Melanie: Now, don't dump 'im b'fore ya even meed 'im! He may be a great guy fer you. Jus' make sher there'er no strings attached b'fore ya go out.
real.en: Now, don't dump him before you even meet him! He may be a great guy for you. Just make sure there are no strings attached before you go out.
real.zh: 别还没见面就把人家甩了！他也许很适合你。出去之前说清楚不附带任何承诺就好。
real.speaker: Melanie
real.origin: 教材口语对照

real.original: Susan: Fine. You go out with 'im.
real.en: Fine. You go out with him.
real.zh: 好啊，那你去跟他约会吧。
real.speaker: Susan
real.origin: 教材口语对照

cards.en: Hi—you must be John's cousin Matt, right? From San Diego?
cards.zh: 嗨，你一定是约翰的表弟马特吧？从圣地亚哥来的？

cards.en: Correct! I just got in last night.
cards.zh: 没错！我昨晚刚到。

cards.en: That sounds awesome. How long are you staying?
cards.zh: 听起来太棒了。你准备待多久？

cards.en: I'm looking forward to hearing what John has in store for me.
cards.zh: 我很期待听听约翰为我安排了什么。

cards.en: I'm so glad to meet you in person.
cards.zh: 很高兴当面见到你。

cards.en: We have a lot in common.
cards.zh: 我们有很多共同点。

cards.en: I'd love to grab a bite before it gets too late.
cards.zh: 我想趁还没太晚先吃点东西。

cards.en: To be honest with you, I really can't stand that dark color on the walls.
cards.zh: 说实话，我真的受不了墙上那种暗沉的颜色。

cards.en: Well, if you have all day, I'll describe him to you.
cards.zh: 好吧，如果你有一整天的时间，我就给你讲讲他。

cards.en: But basically, do you get along with him?
cards.zh: 不过总的来说，你跟他相处得来吗？

cards.en: Then at least he doesn't leave a mess in the kitchen.
cards.zh: 那至少他不会把厨房弄得一团糟。

cards.en: No wonder you're getting along so well.
cards.zh: 难怪你们相处得这么好。

cards.en: I haven't seen you for ages.
cards.zh: 好久没见到你了。

cards.en: Do you have time for a cup of coffee?
cards.zh: 你有空喝杯咖啡吗？

cards.en: We really need to catch up.
cards.zh: 我们真得好好叙叙旧了。

cards.en: Let's make sure we get together more often.
cards.zh: 以后我们一定要常聚聚。

cards.en: I'd like to make an appointment to see Dr. Sharpe, hopefully next week.
cards.zh: 我想预约见夏普医生，希望能约在下周。

cards.en: How can I help you?
cards.zh: 有什么我可以帮您的吗？

cards.en: What can I do for you?
cards.zh: 我能为您做些什么？

cards.en: I need a complete physical.
cards.zh: 我需要做一次全面体检。

cards.en: What's your go-to drink at Starbucks?
cards.zh: 你去星巴克通常点什么饮料？

cards.en: Mind if I join you?
cards.zh: 介意我加入吗？

cards.en: Just give me a heads-up if you need a ride.
cards.zh: 如果需要搭车，提前告诉我一声。

cards.en: Do you want pizza or pasta? Make up your mind!
cards.zh: 你要披萨还是意大利面？快决定吧！

cards.en: I feel like I aced that interview, so I'm pretty sure the job is mine.
cards.zh: 我觉得面试表现特别好，所以很有把握得到这份工作。

cards.en: Get lost!
cards.zh: 走开！

cards.en: I feel lost without you.
cards.zh: 没有你，我感到不知所措。

cards.en: Don't lose your patience.
cards.zh: 别失去耐心。

cards.en: You really know how to cheer me up.
cards.zh: 你真懂得怎么让我振作起来。

cards.en: I already feel much better.
cards.zh: 我已经感觉好多了。

cards.en: I care about you.
cards.zh: 我很在乎你。

cards.en: You are my best friend and have been from the get-go.
cards.zh: 你是我最好的朋友，从一开始就是。

cards.en: What time does the movie start?
cards.zh: 电影几点开始？

cards.en: I'm looking forward to seeing this movie.
cards.zh: 我很期待看这部电影。

cards.en: What are you doing tomorrow?
cards.zh: 你明天打算做什么？

cards.en: We don't have to decide now, since we're still in our freshman year.
cards.zh: 我们现在不必决定，毕竟还在读大一。

cards.en: Anybody else want to put their two cents in?
cards.zh: 还有谁想发表一下看法吗？

cards.en: What do you think?
cards.zh: 你怎么看？

cards.en: I have to agree with April and Katie on this one.
cards.zh: 这件事上我得赞同艾普和凯蒂。

cards.en: She isn't known for thinking outside the box.
cards.zh: 她并不以打破常规思考见长。

cards.en: Don't tell me you broke your leg.
cards.zh: 别告诉我你把腿摔断了。

cards.en: So when did it happen?
cards.zh: 这是什么时候发生的？

cards.en: What a bummer!
cards.zh: 真扫兴！

cards.en: Sit down here for a minute and tell me all about it.
cards.zh: 在这里坐一会儿，跟我好好讲讲。

cards.en: Would you like to have the loaf sliced?
cards.zh: 您需要把这条面包切片吗？

cards.en: Do you have any whole wheat bread?
cards.zh: 你们有全麦面包吗？

cards.en: We're out at the moment. May I suggest some rye bread?
cards.zh: 现在卖完了。推荐您试试黑麦面包，可以吗？

cards.en: I'll just take a cheesecake.
cards.zh: 我就要一个芝士蛋糕吧。

cards.en: Debbie and Becky are attending a party.
cards.zh: 黛比和贝姬正在参加派对。

cards.en: I don't know why I let you convince me to come here. I hate parties.
cards.zh: 真不知道我为什么会被你说服来这里。我讨厌派对。

cards.en: Would you get a grip? This is going to be a blast!
cards.zh: 冷静一点，好吗？这次肯定会很好玩！

cards.en: Oh, no. Look who just walked in. Sheila Hampton. I can't stand her. She always gets on my case because she doesn't like the way I dress.
cards.zh: 糟了，看看谁来了。希拉·汉普顿。我受不了她。她总因为不喜欢我的穿着而找我麻烦。

cards.en: What?! Did you get a load of that tiny dress she's wearing? Her belt's so tight it looks like she's being cut in half! Hey, isn't that Ernie Milton she's with?
cards.zh: 什么？！你看见她穿的那条小裙子了吗？腰带勒得像把她截成两半！和她在一起的不是厄尼·米尔顿吗？

cards.en: Yeah, you're right. He's gained so much weight! And what's up with his hair?
cards.zh: 没错。他胖了好多！他的头发又是怎么回事？

cards.en: What hair? I don't know what you think, but I think it's a rug.
cards.zh: 什么头发？不知道你怎么想，我觉得那是假发。

cards.en: No way! You're putting me on! He was such a hunk! He's changed so much in ten years!
cards.zh: 不会吧！你在逗我！他以前可是个大帅哥！十年变化太大了！

cards.en: I remember. I wonder what happened to him. Uh oh. I think Sheila's waving at us. They're both coming this way!
cards.zh: 我记得。不知道他经历了什么。不好，希拉好像在朝我们挥手。他们两个都往这边来了！

cards.en: Oh, no. Run!
cards.zh: 糟了，快跑！

cards.en: Bill and Liz are shopping for dinner.
cards.zh: 比尔和莉兹正在买晚餐食材。

cards.en: Chicken's only twenty-nine cents a pound. Talk about rock-bottom prices!
cards.zh: 鸡肉一磅才二十九美分，真是低到不能再低了！

cards.en: I know. They've been slashing their prices all week.
cards.zh: 可不是嘛。他们整周都在大幅降价。

cards.en: I have an idea. Let's pick up some chicken and veggies and make a big salad tonight. We could also buy a cake for dessert.
cards.zh: 我有个主意。买些鸡肉和蔬菜，今晚做一大份沙拉吧。还可以买个蛋糕当甜点。

cards.en: Great idea! Look at this pastry section. It's to die for! Just look at all these cakes! The smell of these pastries is making my mouth water.
cards.zh: 好主意！看看糕点区，太诱人了！这么多蛋糕！闻着这些糕点，我都流口水了。

cards.en: Wait! Did you see the price of these cakes? They cost more than the chicken. What a rip-off! Let's just make one from scratch. It'll be a lot cheaper.
cards.zh: 等等！看见蛋糕的价格了吗？比鸡肉还贵，真坑人！我们还是自己从头做一个吧，便宜多了。

cards.en: I think you're right. Let's hurry and get the checker to ring up our purchases. I'm starving!
cards.zh: 你说得对。快让收银员结账吧，我饿坏了！

cards.en: George and David are at the movies.
cards.zh: 乔治和大卫在电影院。

cards.en: It's a good thing we got tickets early. The movie's a sellout!
cards.zh: 幸好我们早买了票，这部电影的票都卖光了！

cards.en: They must have been plugging this movie for weeks. Now it's a blockbuster!
cards.zh: 他们肯定宣传这部电影好几个星期了，现在成了卖座大片！

cards.en: The critics must really be surprised that it turned out to be a sleeper.
cards.zh: 它竟然成了意外走红的电影，影评人一定很吃惊。

cards.en: I'll say. They said it was going to be a bomb and that the performers couldn't act their way out of a paper bag.
cards.zh: 可不是嘛。他们还说这会是部失败之作，演员根本不会演戏。

cards.en: Well, yesterday I saw a write-up where the reviewer gave it two thumbs up. He said there were a lot of funny lines.
cards.zh: 昨天我看到一篇评论，作者大力推荐，说里面有很多好笑的台词。

cards.en: Reviewers never seem to agree on anything. When's this thing going to start? It should have started an hour ago. Let's get the show on the road!
cards.zh: 影评人似乎从来意见不一。这电影什么时候开始？一小时前就该开始了，赶紧开始吧！

cards.en: Chris and Marie are on vacation.
cards.zh: 克里斯和玛丽在度假。

cards.en: It's a good thing this B&B was able to put us up for the night. All the hotels in town were booked solid.
cards.zh: 幸好这家民宿能让我们住一晚，镇上的酒店全都订满了。

cards.en: So, what should we do now? Hey, I have an idea. Tonight, let's grab a cab and hit the town. Maybe we can go sightseeing before dinner.
cards.zh: 那现在做什么呢？有了，今晚打车去城里玩吧，也许晚饭前还能逛逛景点。

cards.en: And since we're on vacation, we can stay up till all hours of the night and sleep in tomorrow.
cards.zh: 既然在度假，我们可以玩到深夜，明天睡个懒觉。

cards.en: Great! Then in the afternoon, we can take a dip and hang out by the pool. It'll be nice to soak up some sun.
cards.zh: 太好了！下午可以游会儿泳，在泳池边休息，晒晒太阳一定很舒服。

cards.en: And tomorrow night, we could take in a movie!
cards.zh: 明天晚上还可以看场电影！

cards.en: Karen's at the airport waiting for Steve to arrive.
cards.zh: 凯伦在机场等史蒂夫到达。

cards.en: I'm sorry we're so late. We had an unexpected two-hour layover some place way out in the boonies. You know, I almost missed the flight entirely because of all the traffic! So I arrived late and got bumped. Luckily, they agreed to put me on standby. All I had was a carry-on, so it was easy.
cards.zh: 抱歉，我们晚了这么久。飞机意外在一个偏远地方停了两小时。路上太堵，我差点彻底错过航班！我到得晚，座位被取消了。幸好他们同意让我候补。我只有随身行李，所以还算方便。

cards.en: It's a good thing you travel light. Well, with the jet lag, I imagine you're pretty wiped out.
cards.zh: 幸好你轻装出行。加上时差，我想你一定累坏了。

cards.en: Actually, I'm pretty wired after all that traveling. At least I got a free ticket for being a frequent flyer!
cards.zh: 其实折腾这一趟后我反倒很亢奋。至少作为常旅客，我还拿到了一张免费机票！

cards.en: So, how was it traveling on the red-eye?
cards.zh: 那坐红眼航班感觉怎么样？

cards.en: It got a little bumpy for a while. Luckily, I never had to use the barf bag!
cards.zh: 有一段时间有点颠簸，幸好没用上呕吐袋！

cards.en: Cecily and Jim are grabbing a bite.
cards.zh: 塞西莉和吉姆在吃点东西。

cards.en: I know we were going to go Dutch for lunch, but since today's your birthday, lunch is on me.
cards.zh: 本来说好午饭各付各的，不过今天是你生日，这顿我请。

cards.en: Well, I was planning on cutting down, but if you're paying, I'm going to pig out!
cards.zh: 本来打算少吃点，不过既然你请客，我要大吃一顿！

cards.en: Good! It's your birthday! Have whatever you want. I feel like having a big juicy burger and a side of fries. How about you?
cards.zh: 好啊！今天你过生日，想吃什么都行。我想来一个鲜嫩多汁的大汉堡，配薯条。你呢？

cards.en: I'll have the same. In fact, I think I'll also get an order of onion rings, potato salad, some baked beans, cole slaw, and some biscuits. And to satisfy my sweet tooth, I'll get a slice of chocolate pie. You know what a chocoholic I am!
cards.zh: 我也一样。另外还想点洋葱圈、土豆沙拉、焗豆、卷心菜沙拉和小面包。为了满足我对甜食的渴望，再来一块巧克力派。你知道我多爱巧克力！

cards.en: Jim, your eyes are bigger than your stomach.
cards.zh: 吉姆，你眼馋肚饱，点得比吃得下的多。

cards.en: Maybe you're right. Okay. Skip the salad.
cards.zh: 也许你说得对。好吧，不要沙拉了。

cards.en: I have a feeling you're going to need a doggie bag for all the leftovers. And I'm going to need to get a second job to pay for this lunch!
cards.zh: 我感觉这些剩菜得给你打包。而我得再找份工作，才能付得起这顿午饭！

cards.en: John's showing Mark his new car.
cards.zh: 约翰正在给马克看他的新车。

cards.en: Is this your new car? It's beautiful!
cards.zh: 这是你的新车吗？太漂亮了！

cards.en: Thanks. It's sure a step up from the clunker I used to have. Hop in and I'll take you for a spin.
cards.zh: 谢谢，比以前那辆破车强多了。上来吧，我带你兜一圈。

cards.en: Just be careful. I know about your lead foot. You don't want to get into a fender bender! And you definitely don't want to get hauled in by a cop for speeding or running a light.
cards.zh: 小心点，我知道你爱踩重油门。你可不想发生剐蹭，更不想因为超速或闯红灯被警察带走！

cards.en: Don't worry. I promise I'm not going to total my car or get arrested my first day having a new car.
cards.zh: 放心，我保证不会刚有新车第一天就把车撞报废或被逮捕。

cards.en: Okay, but be careful. The road to Nancy's house is full of potholes and you don't want to get a blowout.
cards.zh: 好吧，还是小心点。去南希家的路上到处是坑，你可不想爆胎。

cards.en: Don't worry! I'll take it slowly. Besides, since this is rush hour, we're not going to be able to go very fast with all the bumper-to-bumper traffic! But once it clears up, I'm going to punch it!
cards.zh: 放心，我慢慢开。再说现在是高峰期，车挨着车也开不快。不过路一通，我就要踩油门了！

cards.en: Lee and David are talking about Eric.
cards.zh: 李和大卫正在聊埃里克。

cards.en: I just heard that Eric flunked our psych class! Is that true?
cards.zh: 听说埃里克心理学挂科了，是真的吗？

cards.en: Yeah, I can't believe it. It's never happened to him before! He always gets straight A's on the pop quizzes and he even aced the midterm. How could he possibly blow the final?
cards.zh: 是啊，真不敢相信。以前从没这样！他突击测验总拿全优，期中也考得特别好，怎么会搞砸期末？

cards.en: That's because he started to cut class all the time and stopped studying. I passed it because I pulled an all-nighter trying to cram for it.
cards.zh: 因为他后来总逃课，也不学习了。我为了临时抱佛脚熬了一整夜，才考过。

cards.en: I've never taken such a killer test in my life. Unfortunately for Eric, the professor isn't allowing him to take a make-up.
cards.zh: 我从没考过这么难的考试。不幸的是，教授不允许埃里克补考。

cards.en: He should have dropped the class when he had the chance!
cards.zh: 有机会的时候，他就该退掉这门课！

cards.en: Karen and Janet are talking on the phone.
cards.zh: 凯伦和珍妮特正在通电话。

cards.en: Hi, Janet. I haven't heard from you in a while. How are you?
cards.zh: 嗨，珍妮特，好久没你的消息了。你怎么样？

cards.en: I've been feeling under the weather. I felt blah all morning. Then by the afternoon, I was as sick as a dog. I started running a fever and actually thought I was going to pass out! Finally I had Brad take me to the doctor who said it was a bad case of the flu which just has to run its course. I should be raring to go soon.
cards.zh: 最近不太舒服，整早没精神，下午更是病得厉害。我开始发烧，真以为要晕倒！最后让布拉德带我看医生，说是严重流感，只能等它自然恢复。我应该很快就能精神抖擞了。

cards.en: Well, it sounds like you'll definitely pull through. It takes a while to bounce back after having the flu, but I'm sure you'll be back in the pink soon. Just try to take it easy for a while.
cards.zh: 听起来你肯定能康复。流感后恢复需要时间，但你很快就会恢复健康的。这阵子尽量好好休息。

cards.en: You're right but I'm too antsy to just lie in bed. I get bored out of my mind!
cards.zh: 你说得对，可我实在闲不住，光躺床上会无聊疯的！

cards.en: I know what you mean. The last time I was sick, I started to go stir crazy!
cards.zh: 我明白。上次生病时，我待在家里也快憋疯了！

cards.en: Susan's telling Melanie about her date.
cards.zh: 苏珊正在向梅拉妮讲她的约会。

cards.en: You have to tell me about your blind date. How was it? Was he drop-dead gorgeous? Was it love at first sight?
cards.zh: 快跟我说说你的相亲吧。怎么样？他帅呆了吗？你们一见钟情了吗？

cards.en: Hardly! First of all, I waited for an hour before he finally picked me up. I just assumed that I was being stood up. Then when he finally did show up, I opened the door to find the biggest nerd standing there! By the end of the evening, he told me that he had a crush on me and then started talking about tying the knot!
cards.zh: 才没有！我等了一小时他才来接，还以为被放鸽子了。他终于出现，我开门却发现站着个超级呆子！到晚上快结束时，他说喜欢我，接着就谈起结婚！

cards.en: On the first date?! It was probably just puppy love. Listen, my advice to you is that the next time he asks you out, just turn him down and run in the opposite direction! Whatever you do, you certainly don't want to lead him on.
cards.zh: 第一次约会就这样？！多半只是一时迷恋。我建议下次他约你就拒绝，赶紧远离！无论怎样，都别让他误以为你也喜欢他。

cards.en: I'm supposed to go out with another guy next week, but I've decided to break our date. I just can't go through this again.
cards.zh: 本来下周要和另一个男生出去，不过我决定取消。我实在不想再经历一遍。

cards.en: Now, don't dump him before you even meet him! He may be a great guy for you. Just make sure there are no strings attached before you go out.
cards.zh: 别还没见面就把人家甩了！他也许很适合你。出去之前说清楚不附带任何承诺就好。

cards.en: Fine. You go out with him.
cards.zh: 好啊，那你去跟他约会吧。
